name: Whisper Model Installer
description: One-click installer for the faster-whisper-base speech-to-text model. Downloads Systran/faster-whisper-base from the hf-mirror.com mirror via a local loopback sidecar and installs it into your default Hugging Face cache directory in the standard models--Systran--faster-whisper-base layout, so faster-whisper and huggingface_hub find it offline. Live progress, cancel, and already-installed detection.
author: Randa168

post_install.summary: Run the bundled sidecar (sidecar/sidecar.py) on 127.0.0.1:17799, then approve the sidecar proxy in Settings -> Extensions. Downloads go to your default Hugging Face cache (~/.cache/huggingface/hub).
